svg.title: ReplacementPlates.uk homepage — first three sections after hero
svg.desc: A glassmorphic dark and light UI design for the made-to-order explainer, replacement reasons, and number plate style chooser sections.

g.text: A clear, simple process from registration to delivery.
Pick what you need, upload your documents, and we make it right.
Preview your plate as you build.
Front, rear, or a matching pair.
Royal Mail delivery or Ilford collection.
Order before 2pm on a working weekday
DVLA-registered supplier (RNPS 75449) • 12,000+ plates sold since Jan 2025
From damage to loss or an MOT query, there are
many reasons you might need new plates.
Find the right next step below.
A broken plate can be hard to read and
may not meet legal display requirements.
Worn backing or characters that are
hard to read are common reasons.
Report it to the police first, then
Order just the plate you need.
Order a single plate and tell us the size
and style of the one you're keeping.
A bike rack or trailer hides your plate
A trailer must show the same plate as
the towing vehicle and must not obscure it.
Choose your style, priced per plate.
Every style is made to order. Choose a single plate or matching pair.
All prices are per plate; a pair is two plates (front and rear) at the price shown.
Also made to order: Motorcycle • Short • Hex • Japanese import • Oversized
